description: Performs an approximate nearest neighbor search query in a vector index using a query vector. By default, it returns the keys of approximate nearest neighbors.

researchLinks.description: Security Analysis of Amazon S3 Vectors and LLM Retrieval

securityImplications: Attackers might use QueryVectors to run semantic searches against a vector index and pull back indexed proprietary content behind a RAG knowledge base.

simulation.value: aws s3vectors query-vectors --vector-bucket-name TrailDiscover --index-name TrailDiscover --query-vector float32=0.1,0.2 --top-k 10
